business_problem: Luxia Agro is an Argentine company specializing in the import of phytosanitary products for the country's agricultural sector. With a core team of just 10 people, the company has built a reputation for quality and service in a market where competition is intensifying rapidly.
solution_summary: Before Google Cloud, a single change mid-route could derail our entire tracking system. By embedding its intelligence into our logistics engine, we automated 80% of our workflow and gained an incredible level of flexibility. Google Cloud allowed us to bypass the market hype and put AI to work where it truly matters. The answer was the heart of the business: the import process itself. Partner Nider recommended Google Cloud and its Gemini models, more specifically Gemini 3.5 Flash, as the most prepared option in the market, and for a company that values trust in its partnerships, that recommendation was all it took. With Google Cloud in place, Luxia Agro built a comprehensive foreign trade management platform that replaced every informal process with a structured, traceable, and largely automated flow.
